boundedQuestion: When a successor artifact names or retains an earlier revision, what proves that the exact parent was eligible to seed the successor rather than merely available and hashable?

covered: EPHEMERAL-PUBLIC-PARENT-NOT-REPLAYABLE-001 requires immutable parent identity and replayability.
REJECTED-DESCENDANT-QUARANTINE-001 prevents rejected ancestry or copied rejected content from silently returning.
currentBestViewComparison.newDiscriminator: Parent content identity and parent eligibility are orthogonal. An immutable, replayable parent still cannot seed an accepted lineage unless a scoped verifier verdict authorizes that exact parent and the child receipt binds the inherited and changed scopes.

actualObservation.subject: Motor private intermediate packages R15-R17

r15.receiptDecision: eligible partial shared-front baseline for root choice; not complete front-face or optical fidelity

r16.readmeClaim: developed from R15 shared nose support
r16.receiptBoundary: partial grille improvement; lower frame and lowest bar remain occluded

r17.embeddedBaselineIdentity: R15, not evidence of an exact R16 parent binding
r17.receiptBoundary: eligible partial baseline for root acceptance; schematic bumper and lens remain

preservedClaims: Local numerical and visual evidence remains evidence for each exact package.
R17 may remain a technical candidate; this gate does not label it rejected or erase its local improvement.
No production, user acceptance, or canonical-root promotion is inferred.

decisionOrder: Reject digest mismatch before considering eligibility.
Hold when exact parent identity is absent.
Hold when exact parent is known but its scoped eligibility verdict is absent.
Quarantine rejected scope unless exact current user reauthorization covers it.
Only then classify the child as eligible for ordinary candidate verification.

activation.rollbackPoint: Remove this Candidate if one real Motor trial shows parent identity plus scoped parent eligibility cannot discriminate an invalid inherited baseline from a valid child candidate.

requestedAnswer: Is exact R16 the intended parent of R17?
Was R16 accepted for the specific lamp/grille scope inherited by R17?
Which R16 scopes remain rejected or unknown?
What minimal verifier run binds R17 to exact R16 without promoting unrelated scopes?
